headline: Meta Platforms Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Data Protection Case
summary: Meta Platforms has been ordered to pay $25 billion in a New Mexico consumer data protection case accusing the company of misleading users regarding data access and internal policies.
why: Regulatory fines and legal judgments of this magnitude directly impact a tech giant's cash flows, legal reserves, and investor sentiment regarding data privacy compliance costs.
